issue_context.title: New credentials, ViCare doesn’t work
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I had to change my ViCare credentials. Now the integration doesn’t work and I can’t find a way how to update my credentials.


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

Core-2023.10.5

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

Core-2023.10.5

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

ViCare

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/vicare/

### Diagnostics information

I already tried to delete the .save file but I didn’t find it.

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_
comments:
We probably should [handle expired credentials](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/integration_setup_failures/#handling-expired-credentials) in the integration correctly.

The credentials are stores in `config/.storage/core.config_entries`, I think you can edit that via terminal or samba share.

You may need to delete the token file `config/.storage/vicare_token.save`.

I edited the core.config_entries. Thanks for that.
But yes you should think about a better handling of that. I can tell you you know a lot of people who wouldn't manage this because this kind of knowledge is definitely nothing for a general user ;)

review_comments:
Since you are using `unique_id`, you could do the following:

```suggestion
        self.entry = await self.async_set_unique_id(self.context["unique_id"])
```
